summary: Dominari Holdings Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing inducement agreements with holders of Series B warrants to reduce market overhang. Holders could exercise warrants at a reduced cash price of $2.50 per share (Option A) or exchange warrants for common stock at a 10:3 ratio with no additional consideration (Option B). The company expects ~$3.67 million gross proceeds from Option A and to issue ~150,000 shares from Option B, leaving ~1.2 million warrants outstanding. Exchange shares were issued under Section 3(a)(9) exemption. The filing signals a capital-return structure via warrant repricing and conversion, not a traditional buyback. Watch for further dilution management and warrant overhang reduction.
